title: 第2章 她要他！
slug: 万一小叔对假千金是柏拉图呢
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“谢谢。”

宋瓷轻声道谢，轻声上车。

车子发动，平稳地驶入黑夜。

车内，宋瓷低着头，与男人之间隔了一个人的距离。

黝黑的眼珠微转，宋瓷的眼睫上还挂着泪珠，却是稍稍眯眼，像是在思考什么。

一个月前，宋瓷开始频繁地做一个梦。

梦里有个声音告诉她，她其实是被宋家抱错的假千金。

她的未婚夫对身为贫困优等生的真千金一见钟情，两人历经磨难，终于修成正果。

再后来，宋瓷假千金的身份被未婚夫戳破，与真千金联手，将她送入精神病院，最终落得个割腕自杀的下场。

对于这种玄而又玄的梦，宋瓷起初是不相信的，但当她得知方喻之最近确实与一个贫困生来往亲密时，还是多了几分心思。

当拿到那份亲缘鉴定报告，看到报告单上的结果时，宋瓷所有的坚持被全面击溃。

——她真的不是宋家的亲生女儿。

所以，方喻之——她的未婚夫为了真千金，会想方设法地戳穿她假千金的身份，还会将她送入精神病院！？

她最后的结局居然是横死在精神病院！？

宋瓷前二十二年顺风顺水，丰衣足食，早就被宠惯了。

她绝不可能放弃现在的优渥生活给方喻之和真千金让路，更不可能坐以待毙，真的等着自己割腕自杀的结局！

如果说整个京市还有谁是宋家和方家都忌惮的人，宋瓷唯一能想到的，就是自己这个没见过几次面的“小叔”——祝砚铮。

她要荣华富贵，她要活命。

——她要祝砚铮。

眼睫微微垂下，车内，宋瓷声音轻软，小心翼翼地看向身旁的男人：“小叔……今天的事，能不能不告诉别人？”

祝砚铮向来对旁人的私事不感兴趣。

男人侧头面向车窗外，一只手撑着太阳穴，闭目养神，没什么情绪地“嗯”了一声。

他与宋哥是过命的忘年交，也是曾经能够交付后背的战友。

但对于这个名义上的“侄女”，祝砚铮并不熟悉，也只是当年从宋北山口中知道一些关于她的事。

听宋哥说，她的女儿很漂亮，从小被家里的老爷子跟眼珠子一样宠着。

还说祝砚铮比他的女儿年长七岁，所以是名副其实的“小”叔。

基于对宋北山的敬重与悼念，祝砚铮不会看着她陷入危险，但更多的，祝砚铮也不会去干涉。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Thank you."

Song Ci thanked her softly and got into the car.

The car started and drove smoothly into the night.

In the car, Song Ci lowered her head, and there was a distance between her and the man.

The dark eyes rolled slightly. There were still tears hanging on Song Ci's eyelashes, but she squinted slightly, as if she was thinking about something.

A month ago, Song Ci began to have a dream frequently.

A voice in her dream told her that she was actually the false daughter of the Song family.

Her fiancé fell in love at first sight with the impoverished top student, the real daughter, and the two went through hardships and finally became successful.

Later, the identity of Song Ci's fake daughter was revealed by her fiancé, and he teamed up with the real daughter to send her to a mental hospital, where she eventually committed suicide by slitting her wrists.

Song Ci didn't believe this kind of mysterious dream at first, but when she learned that Fang Yuzhi had indeed been having close contact with a poor student recently, she became more concerned.

When he got the kinship test report and saw the results on the report sheet, all Song Ci's persistence was completely defeated.

——She is really not the biological daughter of the Song family.

Therefore, Fang Yuzhi - her fiancé will try every means to expose her identity as a fake daughter for the sake of the real daughter, and will even send her to a mental hospital!?

Her final outcome was to die in a mental hospital!?

In the twenty-two years before Song Dynasty, things went smoothly, and he had plenty of food and clothing, so he was already used to being pampered.

There is no way she would give up her current good life to make way for Fang Yuzhi and the real daughter, let alone sit and wait for death, really waiting for her to commit suicide by slitting her wrists!

If there was anyone else in the entire capital whom both the Song and Fang families were afraid of, the only one Song Ci could think of was his "brother-in-law" whom he had not met a few times - Zhu Yanzheng.

She wants glory and wealth, and she wants to live.

——She wants to Zhu Yanzheng.

Her eyelashes were slightly lowered. In the car, Song Ci spoke softly and looked at the man beside her cautiously: "Uncle...can you not tell others what happened today?"

Zhu Yanzheng has never been interested in other people's personal affairs.

The man turned his head to face the car window, held his temple with one hand, closed his eyes to rest, and said "hmm" without emotion.

He and Brother Song were lifelong friends, and they were also comrades who could be trusted to support each other.

But Zhu Yanzheng was not familiar with this nominal "niece" and only knew some things about her from Song Beishan Pass.

I heard from Brother Song that her daughter was very beautiful and had been pampered by the old man at home since she was a child.

He also said that Zhu Yanzheng is seven years older than his daughter, so he is a veritable "little" uncle.

Based on his respect and condolences for Song Beishan, Zhu Yanzheng would not watch her fall into danger, but more importantly, Zhu Yanzheng would not interfere.
